name: THE ONE WHO KNOWS
note: HOB AT THE BACK (doc 05: 'At the back, not singing: Hob, hat in hand'). Cut from room-31's composition master by tools/art/room31-cast.py; examined through THE ONE WHO KNOWS over him. After doc 48 S2 beat 3 -- 'Good turnout.' Beat. 'Better than mine.' -- and he walks': off the hill to the right, on room-31 operation 3's walk (errata 99 G).
barksNote: Hob's lines here are beat 3's, spoken through the room (doc 48 S2).

exit.note: Doc 48 S2 beat 3: 'and he walks.' Off the hill at the right, unhurried, his hat in his hand (room-31 operation 3, cut by tools/art/cut-walk-sheet.py).
exit.redrawn: HIS OWN WALK (art/actors/hob-walk-right, the one he walks everywhere else), lantern in hand and hat back on as he leaves, relit once into the night. Cast-unify 32's funeral walk dropped the lantern in its passing frames and is not used. figureHeight crown to sole under the hat.

sprite.frameNote: 0 watching, lantern and hat · 1 breath (derived) · 2 head bowed · 3 a glance down to the left · 4 the hat to his chest.
sprite.statureNote: Tall (the master drew him a head over the mourners, 368 where the curve's man is 334); held to 1.04, inside the 5% a standing man is allowed (tests/scale.test.ts), so he is drawn 6% under the master.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 Y (Tyler, 2026-11-06: "That's hob!? I feel like he always needs his lamp to remain recognizable" and "we need to use the new version everywhere"). ONE HOB: drawn by cast-unify 32 from his own in-game frames -- the same face, moustache, coat and build -- with his lit lantern (doc 54: the lid opens on Hob's lantern, that night) and his hat in his other hand (doc 05: 'Hob, hat in hand'); relit into the funeral's night. Cast-unify 31's bareheaded Hob without the lantern read as another man and is not used.
